# Operational-risk capital (`oprisk-capital` v1)

Basel III standardised approach (SMA): business indicator, loss component and capital.

**Group:** Operational and non-financial risk · **Mnemonic:** `OPCAP` · **Identifiers:** `OPCAP-…` in `calcId`

Open one with `OPCAP <id>`.

```sutra
sutra: oprisk-capital
version: 1
description: "Basel III standardised approach (SMA): business indicator, loss component and capital."
match: { kind: oprisk-capital, priority: 10 }
title: { pill: Operational and non-financial risk · Operational-risk capital, id: $.calcId }
strip:

  - { label: BI component, bind: $.bic, fmt: compact }
  - { label: ILM, bind: $.ilm, fmt: price2 }

panels:

    kind: hbar
    title: Business indicator components
    key: F2
    rows: $.components
```
